newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins order from U.S. Airadigm.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins order from U.S. Airadigm.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Wednesday it was chosen as network provider by U.S. group Airadigm Communications Inc. when Airadigm launched its personal communications system (PCS) in Appleton, Wisconsin.

Ericsson said in a statement that it was Airadigm's only network equipment provider, supplying mobile switching centres, base station controllers, base stations and the MXE messaging system as well as remote access.
The company did not give a value for the deal with Airadigm.
